scope: Proposition 2.1 (Quantitative correlations in every progression) of the manuscript “Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions” (preprints/Ordinary-two-point-correlations-of-multiplicative-functions-September-24-2026/final.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 007 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ccb6f339a7505db7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is one absolute c > 0 such that, for every fixed h, l ≥ 1 and b ∈ Z, F(X) := 1 X X 1≤n≤X 1n≡b (mod l)λ(n)λ(n + h) ≪h,l (log X)−c (X ≥ 3). The estimate holds for every real X, with no condition on gcd(b, l).
